notes:
Summary: CopperVeil is a mid-market ecommerce SaaS that powers personalized search and support for merchants. They ran a 3-week Hosted API POC and are now sizing Dedicated because they need predictable throughput during promotions and want a VPC deployment with SSO and audit controls.

POC outcomes (quantitative):
- Trial window: 2026-02-25 -> 2026-03-17 (active monitoring).
- Observed baseline QPS: 15-22 (steady), average 18 QPS.
- Observed peak QPS: 120 QPS (15-minute spike during flash sale test).
- Concurrent active requests (observed): steady 6-10, peak 38.
- Average tokens per request (generation + context): 320 tokens (median 210, mean skewed by long-context diagnostics).
- Token mix (by request count): ~60% short (0-64 tokens), ~30% medium (64-512 tokens), ~10% long (>512 tokens).
- Typical request type: product-search + reranking (2-stage: embeddings + generative re-ranker on top).

Performance goals / SLOs:
- 95th latency target: <150ms for reranker (small model path); <250ms for generative completions in production flows.
- Availability target: 99.9% for peak sale days.
- Cost sensitivity: mid (procurement optimizing for predictable monthly commit).

Dedicated sizing ask (initial recommendation from SE):
- Target steady QPS headroom: plan for 3x baseline (to cover growth & buffer) -> target steady capacity ~60 QPS.
- Peak headroom: support short burst capacity to 150 QPS for ~30m windows.
- Concurrency planning: target ~50 concurrent generation slots (assume batching, token averages).
- Model selection: prefer a quantized 8-bit variant of the curated Llama-3-style re-ranker for cost; generative path to use a cost-optimized Llama-3-medium quant profile with fallback to a smaller variant if latency degradations detected.
- Suggested Dedicated nodes: 2 x A100-40GB equivalence (or 4 x A10-class for higher concurrency with autoscale), with 2x for primary serving + 1x warm spare for rolling updates. Final count to be validated against exact model and quantization profile.

Traffic forecasting (12-week):
- Week 1-4 (post-POC): expect 25 QPS steady as they onboard two merchant cohorts.
- Week 5-8: projected 35-45 QPS (seasonal promo tests), occasional daily peaks to 90-130 QPS.
- Week 9-12: 50-75 QPS steady if rollout continues; plan dedicated reserve or autoscale bursts.
- Token consumption estimate: current avg 320 tokens/request * forecasted monthly requests -> rough monthly token burn ~ 1.2B - 3.2B tokens depending on growth path.

Commercial / procurement notes:
- They favor a committed Dedicated monthly price to lower unit cost. Finance asked for 12-month and 36-month TCO scenarios.
- Estimated ARR band communicated (preliminary): $100k - $200k annual based on initial Dedicated sizing + support add-on.

Integration & security:
- Must support SSO (SAML) and KMS integration for key rotation.
- Audit logs retention requested 1 year for API events; embedding retention policy must be contractually limited (customer expects delete-on-demand for PII).
- VPC peering and routing constraints: customer uses strict egress windows; networking team needs a 2-week window to schedule peering.

Open action items (customer-facing):
- Provide Dedicated sizing worksheet with GPU-equivalent options (A100 vs A10) + cost projection (Sophie to deliver v1 2026-03-14).
- SE (Marco) to run 2 model variants through internal perf bench with their token mix and return p95/p99 numbers.
- Security: deliver completed answers for SOC2/KMS integration (drive:/security/copperveil/security-answers.xlsx).
- Legal/Procurement: draft SOW and retention clauses; customer to confirm budget range by 2026-03-25.

Quotes / Customer language:
- During the March 5 call they said: "We need predictable latency during sales — the hosted trial was great but bursts nearly exhausted our quota. If Dedicated can give predictable cost and reserved capacity, we can commit."
